### When Earth Stunk to High Heaven
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-october-10.html
Passage: Genesis 6:6
Points:
- In Noah's generation, human society had descended into severe moral and spiritual decay that deeply grieved God.
- Wickedness had reached an extreme pitch, corrupting every thought and intention continually rather than occasionally.
- God's impending judgment flowed directly from His nature, which is not only loving but also holy and just.
- A righteous God cannot turn a blind eye to unchecked destruction, perversion, and persistent lawbreaking.
- Noah serves as an example showing that believers can live upright, faithful lives even in an intensely ungodly culture.
